_note: Corsi cipher (MAP CXXXVII 620-633). Built from the contemporary decipherment at the foot of doc 627 c.635r, extended by the syllabary rule (base consonant + odd superscript 1=a 3=e 5=i 7=o 9=u) and by context in 620. Tokens: bare letter; letter+digit = syllable; #nn = number group.
_w17: wave17 additions: #1 = x (expressamente, extensece: context x2); sg (o with flag) = e (copy 621 has q=e at 620 l.17, u/"il" at l.5); bare P = qua (copy 621 clear "e quali"). No other change. Ko (K-shaped sign, no digit) = o: contexts fatto, esso, opinione, non, quello, dosso, accordo, nuovo, necessario. bt, Ri: one-off signs read a, i from the word occasione only (kept doubtful). "." = point, no value.
